card.name: Section cross-references in drug labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words right before a section title in label cross-references, such as the colon after PRECAUTIONS or the number in a section heading like 5.2.

modes.label: After PRECAUTIONS
modes.description: A comma or colon right after the word PRECAUTIONS in a see-reference, before a subsection name.
modes.example: (see PRECAUTIONS<<:>> Discontinuation of Treatment With Paroxetine

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A dot or digit inside a numbered heading, just before the heading title.

modes.label: Bracketed see-references
modes.description: The word see or a comma inside a bracketed pointer to Warnings and Precautions.

card.plain: It fires at the joint where a label points to another section and the section title is about to follow.
